scheme_name: Quality Management Standards & Quality Tech Tools (QMS/QTT)
overview: The Quality Management Standards & Quality Tech Tools (QMS/QTT) scheme under the Ministry of MSME aims to enhance the competitiveness of micro and small enterprises by promoting the adoption of quality management systems and modern quality tools. It supports MSMEs in achieving international standards, improving product quality, and gaining market access through financial assistance for certification and technology upgradation. The scheme focuses on building quality consciousness among MSMEs and enabling them to meet global benchmarks.
objectives: Promote adoption of Quality Management Systems (QMS) among MSMEs
Encourage use of Quality Tech Tools (QTT) for process improvement
Provide financial assistance for ISO 9000 and other international certifications
Enhance product quality and market competitiveness of MSMEs
Facilitate access to national and international markets through quality compliance
Support skill development in quality management practices
Reduce rejection rates and improve export potential of MSME products
eligibility: Manufacturing/Service sector MSMEs having valid Udyam Registration (UR) Certificate.
benefits: Financial assistance for adoption of Quality Management Standards and Quality Tech Tools, including subsidies for certification fees, implementation costs, and technology upgradation. The scheme supports MSMEs in achieving national and international quality benchmarks, thereby improving product acceptance, reducing defects, and enhancing export readiness.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of subsidies for Quality Management Systems (QMS) and Quality Tech Tools (QTT) implementation. Specific subsidy percentages and monetary limits are not detailed in the provided evidence, but support is extended to eligible MSMEs for certification and quality enhancement activities.
required_documents: Details of quality certification or technology upgradation project
caveats: Assistance is subject to availability of funds under the scheme
Beneficiaries must not have availed similar benefits from other government schemes for the same activity
Claims must be submitted within 30 days from completion of the activity
